title: Reverse the 2026-27 fuel duty freeze from April 2027
description: Budget 2025 cancelled the 2026-27 fuel duty uprating and phased out the 5p cut by March 2027. Switch this on to put duty back on its pre-Budget path from the start year, recovering the revenue the freeze gives up.

baselinePolicy.text: Fuel duty 2026-27 uprating cancelled; 5p cut extended to 31 August 2026 then phased out by March 2027 (Table 4.1 line 3).
alreadyIncludes: Fuel duty freeze for 2026-27 (Budget 2025, Table 4.1 line 3).

lines.title: Fuel Duty: Cancel uprating for 2026-27; extend the 5p cut in rates to 31 August 2026, then increase by 1p from 1 September 2026, 2p from 1 December 2026, and 2p from 1 March 2027

rawSource.note: Reversal: the Treasury's costing with its sign reversed (positive scorecard values reduce borrowing; here receipts positive means more revenue).

caveats: The Treasury's costing is on the OBR November 2025 forecast, not the March 2026 baseline used here; the difference is small relative to the figures. Effects before the start year are not applied.

considerations.text: The Treasury's scorecard figure is the certified direct costing for the measure, including the behavioural response the Treasury and OBR agreed; see the Budget 2025 policy costings document for the method.

interactions.text: Both change fuel duty rates; the combined effect is approximate.
